hardNegativeRule: At least max(25% of partition queries, 25) queries must have two or more reviewed hard negatives; this proposal records two specific candidates per query.
morphologyDefinition: A morphology/inflection row must show an explicit grammatical form contrast between the query and its positive passage/title for the same lemma or referent.
unjudgedDiagnosticPolicy: No unjudged diagnostic distractors are converted to judged qrels.
reviewRowsCanonicalization: UTF-8 JSONL bytes in questions.jsonl order, one compact JSON object per line, LF after the final record; the recorded SHA-256 covers these exact bytes.
reviewRowsSerialization: JSON.stringify object order as committed; no re-sorting or whitespace normalization during verification.
